LESSON: WRITING 12.4.1 PARAGRAPHS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.4: Writing 12.4.1 Paragraphs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 12.4.1 Paragraphs, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to put sentences in the correct order when writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1.  Study the jumbled sentences to establish the idea in each.  Discuss the main idea conveyed in the jumbled words.  Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.  Explore various possibilities with peers to get the correct order of the jumbled sentences, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1.  Study the jumbled sentences to establish the idea in each.  Discuss the main idea conveyed in the jumbled words.  Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication.  Explore various possibilities with peers to get the correct order of the jumbled sentences, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 12.4.1 Paragraphs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and imagination- learner’s fluency is enhanced as they explore various possibilities with peers to get the correct

order of the jumbled sentences.

Values:
Responsibility: Cooperation is enhanced as learner takes up roles in collaborative activities

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life-skills (self-esteem) learner’s esteem is enhanced as the learner improves their writing skills.

Links to other Learning Areas:
Writing in order is useful in Kiswahili and indigenous Language Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Sample jumbled sentences, assistive technology such as universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen grips,

page-turners, adapted digital devices
